title: Optimal Bandits with Switching Costs: $(T/\log(T))^{2/3}$ Regret
abstract: arXiv:2611.29438v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study adversarial bandits with switching costs. For $K$ arms, $T$ rounds, unit switching costs, and oblivious losses in $[0,1]$, we prove that the minimax regret is \begin{equation*}   \Theta\!\left(\min\left\{T,   \frac{K^{1/3}T^{2/3}}{\log^{2/3}(2+T/K)}\right\}\right)\,. \end{equation*} This shows that simple blocking, which plays one arm throughout each block, is suboptimal. Our algorithm makes at most a constant number of switches at random times within each block. The key idea for the improvement is to extract more information per switch by giving greater weight to observations near switching times. We also introduce detours, during which the learner temporarily plays a newly sampled arm. Larger observed losses make a detour more likely. These detours cancel temporal correlation terms induced by blocking while preserving the observations used in the estimates. A matching lower bound follows from a refined analysis of a modified m

translated_title: 带切换成本的最优老虎机算法：$(T/\log(T))^{2/3}$ 遗憾
translated_abstract: 我们研究带有切换成本的对抗性老虎机问题。对于 $K$ 个臂、$T$ 轮、单位切换成本以及 $[0,1]$ 区间内的固定损失，我们证明了极小极大遗憾为 $\Theta(\min\{T, K^{1/3}T^{2/3}/\log^{2/3}(2+T/K)\})$。这表明简单的分块策略（即在每个块内始终播放同一个臂）是次优的。我们的算法在每个块内的随机时刻进行至多常数次数的切换。改进的关键思想是通过给切换时刻附近的观测赋予更大权重，从而在每次切换中提取更多信息。我们还引入了“绕行”机制，在此期间学习器临时播放一个新采样的臂。观测到的损失越大，绕行发生的可能性就越大。这些绕行消除了由分块引起的时间相关性项，同时保留了用于估计的观测。匹配的下界来自对一个修改后的模型……
tldr: 本文研究带切换成本的对抗性老虎机问题，提出一种在块内随机时刻切换并引入“绕行”机制的新算法，将极小极大遗憾改进为 $\Theta(\min\{T, K^{1/3}T^{2/3}/\log^{2/3}(2+T/K)\})$，证明了简单的分块策略是次优的。
en_tdlr: This paper studies adversarial bandits with switching costs and proposes an algorithm with random switch times and a novel "detour" mechanism, achieving minimax regret of $\Theta(\min\{T, K^{1/3}T^{2/3}/\log^{2/3}(2+T/K)\})$ and proving that simple blocking is suboptimal.
